description: Every published relationship touching one entity (employs, manages, invested in, lends to, owns, board member of and more), each with role, dates, currency, evidence class and source. Without a paid plan on a vertical, lists name their first 5 rows and count the rest; each answer states what it withheld.

detail.description: compact: the id, name, type, up to five key facts with their citation and counts of the related rows by type, under 2 KB. research (the default): the full answer.
